<DESCRIPTION>
Cooperate initially and continue cooperating only while the opponent has never defected. This restores the stronger prior behavior (2.66 versus the current 2.65) and prevents repeated exploitation after a detected defection.
</DESCRIPTION>

<CODE>
```python

def policy(own_history, opponent_history):
    return 0 if len(opponent_history) == 0 or opponent_history.count(1) == 0 else 1
```
